definitions.gloss: remote control; remote operation; remote access
definitions.explanation: Controlling or operating a device, system, or machine from a distance, either through physical remote controls or via network connections.

examples.japanese: パソコンを{遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}する。
このロボットは{遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}で{動|うご}かせます。
examples.english: This robot can be operated by remote control.

examples.japanese: {遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}によるサポートのおかげで、{現地|げんち}に{行|い}かなくても{問題|もんだい}を{解決|かいけつ}できた。
examples.english: Thanks to remote support, we were able to solve the problem without going on-site.

notes:
A compound of {遠隔|えんかく} (remote, distant) and {操作|そうさ} (operation, control). Covers both physical remote control of devices and digital remote access to computers and systems.

USAGE:
Increasingly common in modern contexts — from IT support and remote desktop access to drone operation and smart home technology. Can be used as a suru verb: {遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}する (to operate remotely).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}する — to operate remotely
- {遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}が{可能|かのう} — remote operation is possible
- {遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}ソフト — remote access software
- {遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}ロボット — remotely operated robot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- リモコン — remote control (the handheld device)
- {遠隔|えんかく} — remote, distant (the prefix alone)
- リモートアクセス — remote access (IT loanword)
